## Purpose
What problem does this change address? Link its task or issue.

## Scope and limitations
Describe the affected contracts, explicit non-goals, dependencies and decisions.

## Validation
- [ ] Relevant tests and regressions executed
- [ ] Source and documentation checks executed
- [ ] Actual results, skips, warnings and exact head recorded
- [ ] Combined candidate reviewed against the current main
- [ ] Documentation and evidence updated where applicable

Record commands and receipts or CI links below. Mark non-applicable items with an explanation; do not claim checks that did not run.

## Security, data and authority
Describe changed trust boundaries, source permissions and external services. Do not attach credentials, raw data, private source contents or sensitive logs. A passing CI does not authorize ingestion, deployment or business actions.
